params.1275: To make a redberry pie, first combine water and flour into pastry dough.
params.1276: Use the dough with a pie dish to make a pie shell - Beefy Bill can sell you a pie dish.
params.1277: Fill the pie shell with redberries (you can find some on bushes south of Varrock's south-east wall).
params.1278: Cook the pie on a range or stove.
